adaptations.title: 修复与推测分开交付
adaptations.adaptation: 先标出划痕、缺损、褪色和不可判断的内容；先做局部修补，再处理整体影调。人物五官和历史文字逐区比对。上色或补造不存在的细节属于另一个选择，不能混入保真修复。
adaptations.taskCheck: 保留原扫描；同尺寸检查人物和字迹，列出无法恢复的区域。
adaptations.capabilityBoundary: Craft的取样修补不等于生成模型的人脸重建或自动上色。

recipe.title: 老照片保守修复全流程
recipe.inputs: 有扫描图与可辨认的局部损伤；确认是否保持黑白。

steps.purpose: 保留原图层，复制到修复工作层

steps.purpose: 只点选已确认的灰尘，不覆盖眼睛、文字和胶片颗粒
steps.parameterReference: {"points":[[x,y,pressure?],…],"size":1..5000 px=tool size,"hardness":0..100=tool hardness,"opacity":1..100=100,"flow":1..100=100,"spacing":1..1000 (% of size)=Brush Settings spacing,"layer":id?=active,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}=Channels panel target,"type":"contentAware|createTexture|proximityMatch"="contentAware","sampleAllLayers":bool=false}

steps.purpose: 从同材质邻近完好位置采样，沿损伤做短笔触
steps.parameterReference: {"points":[[x,y,pressure?],…],"size":1..5000 px=tool size,"hardness":0..100=tool hardness,"opacity":1..100=100,"flow":1..100=100,"spacing":1..1000 (% of size)=Brush Settings spacing,"layer":id?=active,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}=Channels panel target,"source":[sx,sy] | "offset":[dx,dy],"aligned":bool=true,"sampleLayer":"current|currentAndBelow|all"="current","mode":"normal|…"="normal" → {"damage","offset","aligned","nextSource"}}

steps.purpose: 轻度降噪，保留可识别纹理和胶片颗粒
观察直方图后恢复中间调，黑白场不硬截断
steps.parameterReference: {"inBlack":0..253=0,"gamma":0.01..9.99=1,"inWhite":2..255=255,"outBlack":0..255=0,"outWhite":0..255=255,"red":json,"green":json,"blue":json,"eyedropper":json} (top level = composite; per channel {"inBlack","gamma","inWhite","outBlack","outWhite"} under red/green/blue, gray, cyan/magenta/yellow/black or lightness/a/b; eyedropper = the dialog's Set Black/Neutral Gray/White Point picker {"point":"black|gray|white","at":[x,y],"size":1..101=1} or {"point",…,"color":[r,g,b] 0..1}: black/white set each channel's input black/white to the sample, gray each channel's gamma so the sample turns neutral at its luma; RGB and Grayscale (no gray) only, applied over the given levels) + {"path":"work"|saved path name|{…path}? (the active path: becomes the vector mask; else the selection is the layer mask, or white with no selection)}

checks: 人物边缘与字形未被改造
前后图同尺寸比较，未修区纹理一致
recipe.limits: 大面积缺失和无法辨识的人脸不推测重建；逐分区采样，不把例子坐标用于整张照片。

adaptations.title: 保留身份特征的人像修饰
adaptations.adaptation: 先看缩略图判断主体，再在原尺寸区分暂时性痘印与痣、皱纹、轮廓等身份特征。只对获准区域取样，先少量修，再比较纹理，不能全脸同强度涂抹。
adaptations.taskCheck: 保护区与原图对照；痘印减弱而毛孔和轮廓仍在。
adaptations.capabilityBoundary: 不移植外部生成式换脸或自动美颜调用；坐标由本次照片决定。

recipe.inputs: 明确要修饰临时痘印，保留痣和身份特征。

adaptations.title: 代表样片后再批量调色
adaptations.adaptation: 按光照和色偏分组，各组选一张代表图先修；把白平衡与肤色看清再决定其余照片的起点。预览尺寸可以缩小，最终从原尺寸输入重新处理，不能放大预览充当成片。
adaptations.taskCheck: 逐组检查肤色、白衣和高光，异常曝光单张处理。
adaptations.capabilityBoundary: 不同照明不共用一套白平衡；不依赖Adobe账户、预设服务或外部初始化工具。
